summary: aTyr Pharma filed an 8-K reporting a mutual termination agreement with Kyorin Pharmaceutical, effective July 30, 2026, ending their collaboration and license agreement for efzofitimod in Japan. Kyorin had previously given 90-day notice of termination without cause on May 12, 2026; the Termination Agreement accelerated the end date and covered wind-down activities. All rights to develop and commercialize efzofitimod globally revert to aTyr, which now holds worldwide rights. No financial terms, payments, or change-of-control involve; this is purely a contract termination restoring rights. Watch for potential new partnerships or a global commercialization strategy for efzofitimod.
